verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents read access to cap table data: capitalization tables, SAFEs, convertible notes, option grants, and formulas for fully diluted percentages. Nothing describes a priced-round or scenario-modeling feature covering dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, or pro-forma ownership, nor any way to share scenarios with counsel or investors. Retrieval endpoints and percentage formulas are developer building blocks, not the modeling capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors
